{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_orders['revenue_clean'] = completed_orders['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the number of completed orders and the mean
print(f'Number of completed orders: {len(completed_orders)}')
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}')"}
